description: Find U.S. manufacturers of a product. Returns (1) registered exporters: companies with a U.S. plant that Fromerica reviewed before publishing, ordered only by how well they match the product (the plan a company pays for does not affect this order), and (2) separately, unclaimed listings of U.S. manufacturers in the same industry built from public government records (not Fromerica members, not verified, not contactable through Fromerica). Always returns the link where the buyer can post a free request for quote (no account, 0% commission); Fromerica looks for matching U.S. manufacturers.

product.description: Product the buyer is looking for, e.g. "tractor parts".
